frequently_asked_questions.question: Does importing limestone from Tianya's Thailand factory avoid US Section 301 tariffs?
frequently_asked_questions.answer: Yes. Products fabricated at Tianya's Thailand manufacturing base undergo authentic substantial transformation and qualify as goods of Thailand origin (Country of Origin: TH). They enter the United States with 0% Section 301 tariffs and 0% AD/CVD duties, backed by an official Certificate of Origin from the Thai Department of Foreign Trade.

frequently_asked_questions.question: What is the difference between transshipment and Tianya's Thailand factory?
frequently_asked_questions.answer: Transshipment (illegal repacking or simple relabeling) is strictly prohibited. Tianya operates an 18,000 m² heavy-industrial manufacturing facility in Rayong/Chonburi equipped with multi-blade gang saws, 5-axis CNC machines, and tumbling barrels that transform raw monolithic quarry blocks into calibrated, finished architectural stone pavers, fulfilling US CBP 19 CFR § 134 rules of origin.

frequently_asked_questions.question: What is the ocean freight transit time from Laem Chabang to the United States?
frequently_asked_questions.answer: Direct container vessels from Laem Chabang Deep Sea Port (THLCH) reach Los Angeles and Long Beach in 18 to 22 days, Oakland in 20 to 24 days, and US East Coast ports (New York, Savannah) in 28 to 32 days.

frequently_asked_questions.question: Can US and European architects request physical sample kits from the Thailand facility?
frequently_asked_questions.answer: Yes. Sample kits featuring all 29 architectural limestone selections across 5 finishes (Tumbled, Antique, Lightly Distressed, Sandblasted & Brushed, Sandblasted) are dispatched via DHL/FedEx Express directly from our Thailand hub to the US, Canada, Australia, and Europe in 3 to 5 business days.

frequently_asked_questions.question: What documentation accompanies each container from Thailand?
frequently_asked_questions.answer: Each shipment includes an official Thai Department of Foreign Trade Certificate of Origin, detailed commercial invoice, packing list, ISPM-15 fumigation certificate, ocean bill of lading, and independent ASTM laboratory physical test reports.
